confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on web searches of aggregated cost-of-living pages and travel guides for Taormina. Those sources included a city page listing cappuccino at about $2.10, a draft beer at about $5.71, an inexpensive meal at about $17 and a mid-range meal for two at about $57. I raised these figures for the July 2026 peak season and Taormina's status as Sicily's priciest resort town. Some of the sources are dated or cover all of Sicily. I did not search for cocktails or wine directly. Those two anchors are inferred from local resort-bar pricing and their usual relationship to beer prices in Italy. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Taormina has very few hostels and peak-season hotel rates swing widely, so the hostel and hotel figures are the least certain. For the FX observation, I used the 18 November 2026 rate of 0.6720 because a search summary confirmed it for that date. A 19 November figure of 0.6677 appeared in the results but could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Taormina with Italian coastal resort towns in peak season, such as those on the Amalfi Coast and Capri, but at somewhat lower prices. I also scaled up from general Sicilian prices.
